stem: Aditya watches a candle burn on a table. He writes two questions: "Why does fire exist everywhere?" and "Does a candle burn longer under a glass jar or in open air?"

parts.text: Which question has been made scientific by turning curiosity into a focused question that can guide careful observation and a check?

options.text: "Does a candle burn longer under a glass jar or in open air?" because it is focused and can be checked.
"Why does fire exist everywhere?" because a big curiosity question is already scientific.
The candle question is not scientific because it uses a household candle.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The candle question is focused and can guide observation or a fair test; the fire question is too broad to check.

teacher.key_rationale: A scientific question is focused and can guide careful observation and explanation. The candle-jar question can; the fire question is too broad.
